sentinel_compatibility_surface.interpretation: Name-only compatibility surface: prefix registration proves an OreDict item registration event, while zero recipe appearance shows no recipe-map use in this dump environment.
sentinel_compatibility_surface.silent_zone_conclusion: The earlier ~285-290 registered-item/zero-recipe estimate was the name-only sentinel population. Under the stable T0-prefix scope only ClayBrick remains; this is not a missed-recipe bulk population.

rule_invariants.note: No L1b classifier rule uses registered_prefix_count. Rules named *item_evidence* refer only to recipe-map item appearances, so they remain live even though every stable material has at least one registered prefix.

closure_gate.policy: components dependencies auto-promote transitively to the strongest consumer layer; unresolved or explicitly blocked CORE components hard-fail. Processing targets degrade routes; byproducts are stripped.

active_fluid_or_dependency_closure.reason: Direct fluid/dependency evidence requires retention to preserve observed closure.
active_fluid_or_dependency_closure.falsifier: A row hits this rule without fluid evidence or an explicit dependency/transitive activation reason.

active_item_evidence.reason: ACTIVE row has registered forms and direct recipe item evidence.

active_without_classified_evidence.reason: Fallback for ACTIVE rows lacking a stronger evidence classification.
active_without_classified_evidence.falsifier: A hit is not ACTIVE, is element-like, or satisfies a stronger item/fluid/dependency evidence rule.

authored_include.reason: Existing authored CrucibleCraft material is a reviewed human input.

element_active_fluid_or_dependency.reason: Element encoding is L1a-verified and the row has direct fluid/dependency evidence.

element_active_item_evidence.reason: Element encoding is L1a-verified and ACTIVE has registered forms plus recipe item evidence.

element_active_unclassified.reason: Fallback for ACTIVE element-like rows not covered by stronger evidence rules.
element_active_unclassified.falsifier: A hit is not ACTIVE, is not element-like, or satisfies a stronger element evidence rule.

empty_material_slot.reason: Material id 0 / Empty is the reserved empty slot.

fictional_material_shelved.reason: Full-range query identifies ids 1181..7999 as post-periodic fictional/sci-fi/magic/joke materials.
fictional_material_shelved.falsifier: A canonical real periodic element or isotope exists with material id in 1181..7999.

isotope_common_active.reason: Common-isotope allowlist is a human phase/scope decision.

isotope_common_active_loose.reason: Common-isotope allowlist is a human phase/scope decision.

isotope_obscure_deferred.reason: The common-isotope boundary and phase placement are human scope decisions.

pending_t0b_non_native_ownership.reason: Non-native alloy/organic ownership awaits T0b 1.21.1 mod inventory decisions.

inferred_review_priority.note: These rows are natural needs_review priority candidates; basis alone does not yet route them into a review bucket.

hot_out_sample.activation_reason: stable canonical GT6 material imported for factual metadata/forms; metadata_only=true (no GT6-registered prefix maps to a CC prefix); runtime decomposition disabled (source ratio is not exactly representable)

notes: All layer/rule/conflict/histogram summaries exclude source_id < 0; name-only records remain in sentinel_compatibility_surface and the complete dropped-record artifact.
Layers are 2D: structural_class × originalMod (elements ignore ownership).
PENDING_T0B = alloy/organic/midband-other with non-native originalMod; await T0b inventory.
Element-like is verified periodic Z=1..118 only; id%10 alone is not identity outside id 10..1180.
SHELVED_FICTIONAL is the verified id 1181..7999 band; residual hidden rows route to NEEDS_REVIEW.
recipe_appearances is FULL expanded map count; template_appearances is the decombinatorialized heat from gt6_recipe_templates.
pending_t0b hot conflicts use template_appearances>=3 when available.
case_collision belongs in L1a alias merge, not L2 review.
Intentional hot drops (FOOD / DONT_SHOW) excluded from OOS conflict tags.
Conflict tags are advisory for review; they do not themselves rewrite tier. Tier correction for component deps is promote_component_closure.
pending_t0b_with_hot_full_evidence flags ACTIVE/hot rows parked only by non-native originalMod (SiliconDioxide class).
